newsitem.title: USA: Tech Data to buy part of Macrotron.
newsitem.headline: Tech Data to buy part of Macrotron.

text.p: Tech Data Corp said Monday it made a share purchase agreement to acquire a controlling interest in Macrotron AG, a German distributor of personal computer products based in Munich.
The company said the transaction will initially consist of the acquisition of 75 percent of the outstanding voting common stock.
The company declined to disclose an acquisition price.
The company said the closing of the transaction is subject to completion of due diligence and the receipt of approval from regulatory authorities and is expected to be completed by July 31, 1997.
The company said Macrotron reported sales and net income of DM1.3 billion ($905 million) and DM7.8 million ($5.3 million), respectively during its most recent fiscal year ended September 30, 1996.
